messages:
sara (product): Quick design check — thinking about moving the simulation legend out of the top overlay and into a left rail next to the canvas. Gives more space for the preview and keeps indicators aligned with rules. Thoughts?

mike (pm): I like left rail for desktop. Makes it easier to scan priority icons vs rule list. Concern: vertical space on smaller laptop screens.

omar (frontend): If we do left rail, we should make it collapsible. Also need to nail keyboard focus order — people will tab between rules and the preview controls.

kate (a11y): Left rail is fine, but: ensure legend items are keyboard reachable and provide text + icon. Icon-only isn't enough. Also aria-live for simulation status changes (play/pause/snapshot).

sara (product): Good call on collapse/tooltip. For mobile we could switch to a bottom drawer or a stacked header. Adding text next to icons recommended by Kate.

omar (frontend): Implementation note: we can reuse existing legend component, just change layout CSS to grid with `grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr`. For collapse behavior use `aria-expanded` on the rail toggle.

kate (a11y): Add `role="region" aria-label="simulation legend"` on the rail, and ensure dark-mode contrast >= 4.5 for text on badges. Also avoid relying on color alone to convey priority (add chevrons or numbers).

sara (product): UX copy question: current legend item "Priority: High" vs "High priority" — which reads better in a compact list?

mike (pm): "High priority" reads better when you scan quickly. Also consider adding a short hover explanation: "Rules with high priority run before lower ones."

omar (frontend): For preview simulation feedback, prefer inline validation messages under the rule name rather than toasts during the playback. Toasts get lost when people are interacting with the canvas.

kate (a11y): Agree. Use `aria-describedby` from the rule to the validation text so screen readers announce it when focus lands. For live sim errors, announce once using `aria-live="polite"`.

sara (product): Design nit: the drag handle currently shows only on hover. Can we make it always visible in compact mode? PMs keep missing ordering affordance in tests.

omar (frontend): Yes, we can add an always-visible small handle in compact list variant. Will need to adjust hit area to avoid accidental drags — maybe `pointer-events` on handle only.

sara (product): minor: legend width 240px feels right in mock, but allow user resize?

mike (pm): User-resizable would be a nice-to-have, but not in MVP. Let's ship fixed size with collapse. Track resize as enhancement.

design-bot: Prototype update: https://figma.redwood.design/proto/preview-rail — added collapse toggle, keyboard flow, and alt text. (snapshot attached)

kate (a11y): Reviewed prototype: focused states look good. One more: ensure the collapse toggle has an accessible name like "Toggle legend" and state exposed. Also check focus order when rail collapses — focus should move to the preview controls, not disappear.

sara (product): Thanks all — action items: Omar to implement rail + collapse + keyboard flow, Kate to add a11y checklist for sim announcements, Mike to adjust copy to "High priority" and add hover helper text. I'll update the mock to include compact variant and mobile drawer.

omar (frontend): Got it — I'll send a brief PR with CSS + `aria-` attrs and a small e2e keyboard test.

kate (a11y): I'll paste the checklist into the ticket when ready.

sara (product): Great, end-to-end follow-up in #design-sync tomorrow if anyone wants to review before merge. :thumbsup:
